requirement: As a user, I want to login with my email and password so that I can access my account
As a customer, I want to search for products by name so that I can find what I need quickly
As an admin, I want to upload a CSV file of products so that I can bulk-import inventory
The user should be able to register with a valid email address and receive a confirmation email
As a buyer, I want to add items to my shopping cart and proceed to checkout so that I can purchase products
